I added a log line to `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py`. I haven't run it or any tests.

It logs `log.info("refund_requested", invoice_id=invoice.id)` at the top of the function, before the amount check, so over-limit attempts are logged too.

Following the project's logging decision in EngramDB, I used structlog instead of the stdlib `logging` module. The invoice id goes in a keyword field, not the message string. I also added `import structlog` and a module-level `log = structlog.get_logger()`.

I didn't check whether structlog is already a declared dependency of the project.
